data.name: Jivraj
data.gender_notes: Jivraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jivraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘jiva’ meaning life and ‘raj’ meaning king. This name signifies the ruler or protector of life. The name Jivraj carries the meaning “Lord of Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jivraj usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine force that preserves and nurtures life.
data.etymology: Jivraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jivraj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
